## U20_Embedded Test Suite

**Mode:** Controller

**States:**
* IDLE
* PRESSURE_FALL
* PEEP_DELIVERY
* INHALATION_TRIGGER
* INHALING
* EXHALING

**Transitions:**
* START -> PRESSURE_FALL
* PRESSURE_FALL -> PEEP_DELIVERY
* PEEP_DELIVERY -> INHALATION_TRIGGER
* INHALATION_TRIGGER -> INHALING
* INHALING -> EXHALING
* EXHALING -> IDLE

**Events:**
* START
* PRESSURE_MET
* PEEP_MET
* INHALATION_DETECTED
* INHALATION_STOPPED

**Guards:**
* PRESSURE_MET: pressure >= commanded pressure * (1 - overshoot)
* PEEP_MET: pressure <= commanded PEEP + PEEP_tolerance
* INHALATION_DETECTED: sensor detects patient inspiration
* INHALATION_STOPPED: sensor detects patient exhalation

**Test Cases:**

```json
[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Controller meets commanded pressure within overshoot",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-63"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Controller is in IDLE state"],
    "inputs": {"commanded_pressure": 20, "overshoot": 0.8},
    "steps": ["START event is sent"],
    "expected": ["Controller transitions to PRESSURE_FALL state"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-002",
    "title": "Controller meets commanded PEEP within tolerance",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-64"],
    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Controller is in PEEP_DELIVERY state"],
    "inputs": {"commanded_peep": 10, "peep_tolerance": 1},
    "steps": ["PEEP_MET event is sent"],
    "expected": ["Controller transitions to INHALATION_TRIGGER state"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-003",

    "kind": "positive",
    "preconditions": ["Controller is in INHALING state"],
    "inputs": {"target_fio2": 0.21, "tolerance": 0.05},
    "steps": ["INHALATION_STOPPED event is sent"],
    "expected": ["Controller transitions to EXHALING state"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-004",
    "title": "Controller reports FiO2 as measured prior to inhalation",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-97"],
    "kind": "positive",

    "inputs": {},

  {
    "id": "TC-005",

    "preconditions": ["Controller is in INHALING state"],
    "inputs": {"air_conditions": {"temperature": 20, "altitude": 1000, "humidity": 50}},

  },
  {
    "id": "TC-006",

    "inputs": {"mode": "assist/control", "pressure_mode": "pressure"},
    "steps": ["START event is sent"],
    "expected": ["Controller enters assist/control mode with pressure-controlled ventilation"]
  },
  {
    "id": "TC-007",
    "title": "Controller prevents acting on absurd commands",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-156"],
    "kind": "negative",
    "preconditions": ["Controller is in IDLE state"],

    "expected": ["Controller ignores the command"]
